description: This file defines a React functional component named 'InfiniteCalendar' which implements an infinitely scrollable calendar view. It manages calendar months, handles scrolling, month navigation, and date selection functionalities, and integrates with various utility and sub-components to render a sophisticated calendar UI.

methods.name: goToMonth
methods.description: Method exposing functionality for external components to programmatically navigate to a specific month in the calendar.

methods.name: resetNumberOfCalendarsToBase
methods.description: Resets the calendar view to a centered date with minimal month buffers.
